_comment_1: Phantom MCP — example mcp.json entry for LM Studio. Paste the 'mcpServers' object into LM Studio → Settings → MCP Servers (Manual / stdio).
_comment_2: DO NOT put model/context settings here. Set those inside LM Studio's model panel — mcp.json launches MCP servers, nothing else.

rationale: Phantom truncates large outputs automatically based on the model's context length, so 16k will work — 32k just gives the model more room to keep multiple tool results in mind at once.
Screenshots default to ~2.5k tokens (downscaled JPEG). desktop_screenshot(hires=true) is much heavier — only use when you need to read fine text.
If you have a small-context model (4k-8k), keep working — phantom will trim outputs more aggressively. Run memory_compact periodically and avoid hires screenshots.

_run_alongside_other_mcp_servers: Phantom is self-contained — no other MCP server is required.
If you do run a second MCP server alongside it, that's fine: LM Studio talks to each over its own stdio pipe and the two memory stores stay independent.
Tool names in this server are namespaced (desktop_*, memory_*, file_*, window_*, process_*, shell_*, agent_*) so the model can route cleanly even with multiple servers loaded.
